items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I think his son used to play a little, his son named Herbert Hart used to play a little saxophone

ctx.x: He didn't play music hardly, no, after he got out here. No, he did not. And strangely enough, his children didn't get into music. I think his son used to play a little, his son named Herbert Hart used to play a little saxophone, but I think Herbert just -- they just got away from

it completely.
But getting back to the Dunbar Hotel, the singing bit, they would come into this Dunbar Hotel and they would request a song. And I kept begging off and saying, 'Well, you know, I don't sing. I'm not a vocalist.' Well, they'd say, 'Well, hum it. Hum it. We like your voice. We just want to hear something.' And then I would say, 'Well, I just don't know too many songs.' Or maybe I would sing a song or two, try to sing, or hum it. Then finally I realized that this was something that they wanted from…
